title: Final Fantasy VII Remake / Rebirth
setting: Industrial sci-fi fantasy; the megacorporation Shinra drains Mako energy from the planet; the eco-rebel group AVALANCHE fights back in the city of Midgar.
style: Cinematic and character-driven. Contemporary spoken Thai with attitude; no archaic ข้า/เจ้า. Keep sarcasm, banter and slang alive.

characters.name: Cloud
characters.voice: male ex-SOLDIER mercenary; cool, terse, aloof, dry; short lines, uses ผม/ฉัน rarely, never ครับ

characters.name: Barret
characters.voice: male AVALANCHE leader; loud, hot-headed, big-hearted; rough casual Thai (ฉัน/นาย), exclamations, no polite particles

characters.name: Tifa
characters.voice: female bar owner and fighter; warm, caring, steady; natural casual speech, ค่ะ rarely

characters.name: Aerith
characters.voice: female flower seller; cheerful, playful, teasing; light casual speech with นะ

characters.name: Jessie
characters.voice: female AVALANCHE member; flirty, upbeat, quick-witted

characters.name: Wedge
characters.voice: male AVALANCHE member; earnest, nervous, food-loving

characters.name: Yuffie
characters.voice: female ninja; hyper, cocky, playful slang

characters.name: Sephiroth
characters.voice: male legendary SOLDIER; cold, calm, menacing; formal, no particles
